services.name: Skydive Links
services.desc: Ready for an adventure you’ll never forget? Skydive Elsinore offers the ultimate thrill of tandem skydiving, paired with breathtaking views of Southern California. Conveniently located just an hour from San Diego and Los Angeles, our facility is the perfect destination for first-time jumpers and adrenaline enthusiasts alike. If you’re ready to experience the rush of freefalling at over 120 mph, Skydive Elsinore will make it unforgettable! After a personalized briefing with your expert instructor, you’ll jump from the plane for an adrenaline pumping minute-long freefall before the parachute opens, allowing you to glide back to earth for an awe-inspiring 4-5 minutes.
